view.description: Open-source AI canvas with text-to-image, image-to-video and more, integrated into Astravia.
login.title: Sign in to the canvas
login.description: Canvas tools call the canvas backend with the browser session. Open the canvas once and sign in there — the session is captured automatically.
log.title: Service log
tips.title: Getting started
tips.login: Open the canvas in your browser and sign in (the first user can register automatically).
tips.mcp: After signing in, the host agent can manage projects, canvases and generation tasks through MCP tools.
tips.dataDir: All data is stored in the plugin data directory.
bridge.title: Model bridge
bridge.description: Astravia relays its own text models into the canvas, so you do not have to paste an API key into the canvas to use the models you already configured here. The bridge only works while this plugin is running.
bridge.connectHost: Use Astravia's text models in the canvas
bridge.publishCanvas: Use the canvas image/video models in Astravia
bridge.channelCreated: Channel created in the canvas, with its models, capability config and free price tier.
bridge.channelUpdated: Channel, models and price tier synced to the canvas.
bridge.exported: The canvas image/video models are now available in Astravia.
bridge.exportedNone: No image or video model in the canvas catalog could be registered: none of them declares a usable generation mode.
bridge.caveat: Text goes only one way: Astravia into the canvas. Canvas image/video models are exposed as a media provider — the host picks the model, the canvas executes, and the keys never leave the canvas. Image-to-image and image-to-video need reference uploads and are not bridged yet.
bridge.limitNoHostMedia: Not the other way round: image/video models configured in Astravia are not handed down to the canvas. The host contributes text inference only; media generation uses the canvas models.
bridge.limitNoReference: Reference images (image-to-image, image-to-video) are not passed through yet: requests started in the host carry a text prompt only.
bridge.error.bridge-token-missing: The canvas service has not started yet. Start it and try again.
bridge.error.canvas-login-required: Sign in to the canvas in your browser once, then try again.
bridge.error.canvas-channel-write-failed: The canvas rejected the channel. Its own message is shown below.
bridge.error.canvas-models-invisible: The models were written, but the canvas catalog does not count them as usable. Check the canvas version and the channel settings; the raw message is below.
bridge.error.no-text-models: Configure at least one text model in Astravia first.
error.startFailed: Failed to start the canvas service
error.installFailed: Failed to install the canvas service
error.stopFailed: Failed to stop the canvas service
error.platformUnsupported: No canvas runtime is published for this platform yet
error.payloadUnreachable: Failed to download the canvas runtime: none of the mirrors or GitHub worked. Retry, or open the progress page to see which sources were tried.
error.payloadCorrupt: The canvas runtime failed its integrity check. Please try again.
error.payloadExtract: Failed to unpack the canvas runtime. Please try again.
error.backendFailed: The canvas backend did not start
error.webBundleMissing: The canvas runtime is missing its frontend files. Please reinstall.
workflow.title: Last workflow
progress.title: Preparing the canvas runtime
next.title: Next step
next.idle.title: The canvas is not running yet
next.idle.body: Start it once: the plugin downloads the runtime for this platform (about 100 MB on first run) and then opens the canvas in your browser.
next.preparing.title: Working on it
next.preparing.body: Downloading, verifying or unpacking the runtime. Keep this panel open: progress above is live, and a stalled download resumes from the last completed chunk.
next.login.title: Sign in to the canvas
next.login.body: Canvas tools reuse the browser session. Open the canvas once and sign in there — the session is captured automatically.
next.ready.title: The canvas is running
next.ready.body: Open it to create a canvas, then configure the model bridge so the canvas can use the models you already set up in Astravia.
next.error.title: The canvas did not start
next.error.body: Read the reason below, then restart. If it is a download problem, clear the residue first so the next attempt does not resume from broken bytes.
models.needsRunning: Start the canvas first: both bridge directions need the service to be running.
models.direction1Body: Registers one channel in the canvas that points back at this plugin, so generations inside the canvas use the API keys you already configured in Astravia — no need to paste them again.
models.direction2Title: Give Astravia the canvas image/video models
models.direction2Body: Registers the image and video models already configured inside the canvas as a host media provider. The host chooses the model, the canvas executes and bills it, and the keys stay inside the canvas instead of being copied into Astravia.
tools.title: What the agent can do with this canvas
tools.description: These tools are served by the plugin over MCP. Ask the agent in plain language — it picks the tool.
tools.unreachable: The tool list is unavailable because the canvas service is not running. Start it and switch back to this tab.
tools.briefHeader: You can operate my Open AI Canvas through these MCP tools:
tools.usageHint: Tool names are for reference. In a conversation just say what you want, for example: create a canvas called launch, add three text-to-image nodes and connect them in order.
diag.title: This machine
diag.description: Everything below is read from the running service. Copy a single row when reporting a problem, or copy the whole block at once.
diag.actionsDescription: Restart when the process is alive but the backend stopped answering. Clear the residue when a download keeps failing — it deletes only partial files, never the installed runtime.
bridge.catalogEmpty: No catalog yet. Sign in to the canvas, then refresh.
bridge.catalogUnsupported: {{count}} model(s) declare no usable generation mode and were skipped.
bridge.error.canvas-unreachable: Cannot reach the canvas backend. Make sure the canvas is running and try again.
bridge.error.canvas-task-rejected: The canvas rejected this request. Its own message is shown below.
bridge.error.no-media-models: The canvas catalog has no image or video model that can be connected.
bridge.mediaIdle: Not registered with the host yet
bridge.mediaRegisteredModels: {{count}} models registered — pick them in the host's generate entry
bridge.mediaDisconnected: Unregistered: the canvas models no longer appear in the host
bridge.mediaScope: Registration hands over model names and capabilities only; the keys stay in the canvas. Generation still runs there — the host just asks.
bridge.projected: The canvas catalog confirms {{usable}}/{{requested}} models as usable ({{blocked}} blocked, {{missing}} missing).
bridge.projectionIdle: No models have been projected into the canvas yet.
bridge.projectionRemoved: Dropped {{count}} stale model(s) from this channel at the same time.
bridge.projectionScope: Model names, capability parameters and one free fixed-price tier are written into the canvas channel. Keys never flow back: the canvas only receives a local bridge token.
bridge.autoSynced: Synced automatically: host text models are in the canvas channel, and the canvas image/video models are registered with the host.
update.title: Version & updates
update.upgrading: Downloading and switching runtimes — this can take a few minutes…
update.upgraded: Runtime switched to {{version}}; the canvas backend restarted.
update.upgradeFailed: Upgrade failed, still running the previous runtime.
update.rolledBack: Upgrade failed and was rolled back — the canvas still works.
update.unreachable: Cannot reach the canvas service. Start the canvas first.
update.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Try again later.
update.bundled: The runtime ships with the plugin: new versions arrive with a plugin update.
overview.updateHint: The plugin bundles one canvas runtime. When upstream publishes a new one you can switch here without reinstalling the plugin.
overview.syncHint: Once both sides have models they are connected automatically. If the canvas cannot see yours, hit Resync.
overview.checkLogin: Sign in to the canvas once in the browser
overview.checkModels: Confirm models are shared both ways
overview.checkAgent: Ask the agent to drive the canvas in chat
